scope: Successor-only correction to the immutable R2 adversarial-review harness; no candidate import, execution, Git mutation, production/test write, or acceptance.

corrections.finding: R2 helper_type_checks used object_type=tree while expecting CODE_PROOF_INPUT_INVALID. tree is a valid enum, so an oversized body correctly reaches CODE_PROOF_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and would falsely reject a conforming implementation.
corrections.change: Use unsupported object_type=tag for the /object_type validation-order cases in both helper APIs; the oversized body is then irrelevant to the expected input-type refusal.
corrections.contract_basis: CODE-GIT-KERNEL-R1 and CODE-GIT-KERNEL-CLARIFICATIONS-R2 allow exactly commit, tree and blob.

corrections.finding: R2 keyed one exact message by code, conflating distinct refusal pointers, reasons, fields, limits and type contexts. The contract fixes a non-source-echoing message but permits validation wording to vary across meaningful contexts.
corrections.change: Key message consistency by code plus instance_pointer, reason, field, limit_name, expected_type and actual_type, preserving repeated-condition checking without requiring one text across different refusal reasons.
corrections.contract_basis: CODE-GIT-KERNEL-R1 closed-error section and its final paragraph distinguish fixed non-source-echoing messages from context-bearing validation wording.

corrections.finding: R2 required the insertion order of helper cap error details even though the error contract freezes required fields and values, not error-detail mapping order.
corrections.change: Retain exact helper cap detail keys and values while removing the invented list(error.details) insertion-order assertion.
corrections.contract_basis: CODE-GIT-KERNEL-CLARIFICATIONS-R2 freezes success-result construction order separately; helper cap details are specified by exact fields and values.

handbuilt_expectation_audit.result: No additional validity mistakes found in the remaining hand-built mutations and expected refusal/success outcomes.
